name: eventos-sociales
description: Social events planner without an app: a wedding, XV años or baptism planned from a countdown template that the couple or the wedding planner adjusts, with vendors, payments, budget, sponsors, guests, tables and the day's program kept exact.

stays_local: the memory file with the events, their tasks, budget, vendors, payments, sponsors, invitations, tables and program (the agent queries it and sees the answers)
a guest list the owner imports from a file: the tool reads it and stores only name, group, seats, RSVP, diet and note
agent_sees: the events, their dates and the plan's tasks
the amounts: budget, contracts, payments and who made them
vendors' names, and their contact data if the owner gives it
the invitations as the owner names them, with group, seats, RSVP, diet, note and table, when it queries them
everything the owner types in the conversation
cannot_guarantee: what the agent sees leaves the computer for the AI provider, under its terms; the guests are third parties who did not choose to share their names or diets: use nicknames or initials if you prefer
the memory file is not encrypted
a dropped task, a removed invitation or a voided payment stops showing but stays in the memory file
there are no notifications or reminders: what is due is shown only when the owner opens a conversation
the template's tasks and suggested budget are general references, not legal or financial advice; civil and church requirements change by place
the memory lives on one computer: two people planning together don't share it automatically
